# BrickFill source contract (v1) and adapters

<!-- Generated by scripts/export_contract_doc.py from src/brickfill/contract.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

BrickFill never reads a retailer's ERP tables directly. It reads three **canonical views**, and a small **adapter**
maps the retailer's own tables to them:

| View | One row per | Primary key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `v_products` | sellable item | `product_id` |
| `v_attributes` | attribute and subcategory where it applies | `attribute_id, subcategory_id` |
| `v_attribute_options` | allowed value of an attribute | `attribute_id, option_id` |

## Writing an adapter

1. Copy `adapters/_template/` to `adapters/<your_adapter>/` (letters, digits and `_`).
2. In each file, write one `SELECT` that returns the canonical columns below with their exact names. The column
   order does not matter, and extra columns are dropped. Resolve fallbacks, flags and code-to-text lookups here, for
   example `COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(erp_title), ''), web_title) AS title` or
   `CASE flag WHEN 'Y' THEN TRUE WHEN 'N' THEN FALSE END AS is_required`.
3. Use placeholders instead of hard-coded names:
   - `{{source}}` is the quoted `adapter_source_catalog`.`adapter_source_schema`.
   - Every key of the `adapter_params` JSON job parameter is available as `{{key}}`. For example,
     `{"pim": "main.pim"}` makes `{{pim}}` usable. Each value must be an identifier or a dotted path; free SQL is
     rejected.
4. Run the **BrickFill · Source contract** job with `adapter=<your_adapter>`. It then:
   - wraps each `SELECT` in a documented view: one `COMMENT` per column (visible in Catalog Explorer), the view
     comment and `TBLPROPERTIES` with the contract version, plus a `CAST` that pins every type;
   - validates the result.

You can also build the three views yourself (dbt, a pipeline) and run the job with `adapter=none` to only validate
them. The mock adapter (`adapters/mock/`) maps the fictional ERP produced by the development mock-data job and is a
complete example.

## Contract checks

Results are appended to the Delta table `contract_check`. `contract_fail_on` (`error`, `warning` or `never`) decides
when the job fails.

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MISSING_COLUMN / WRONG_TYPE | ERROR | A view lacks a canonical column or has another type |
| PK_DUPLICATE | ERROR | More than one row per primary key |
| NULL_IN_NOT_NULL | ERROR | A NOT NULL column is NULL or blank |
| ENUM_INVALID | ERROR | `value_type` or `attribute_role` outside the allowed values |
| GTIN_DUPLICATE | ERROR | The same `gtin` on more than one product |
| GTIN_INVALID | ERROR | `gtin` is not 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits with a valid GS1 check digit |
| OPTION_ORPHAN_ATTRIBUTE | ERROR | An option of an attribute that is absent from `v_attributes` |
| SUBCATEGORY_WITHOUT_ATTRIBUTES | WARNING | A subcategory with active products and no attributes (only editorial content is generated) |
| ATTRIBUTE_SCOPE_UNUSED | INFO | An attribute scoped to a subcategory without products |
| REQUIRED_FLAG_NULL | INFO | `is_required` is NULL, so `attributes_required_default` applies |


## `v_products`

BrickFill canonical products (contract v1). One row per sellable item of the retailer's catalog, the input of the enrichment and the catalog the review app lists. Primary key product_id; gtin is unique. Built by an adapter over the retailer's own tables; see adapters/README.md.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | STRING | **no** | Retailer's stable internal id of the item (SKU code). Primary key. |
| `gtin` | STRING | **no** | GTIN-8, -12 (UPC), -13 (EAN) or -14 of the item, digits only, leading zeros kept. Unique; the enrichment searches the web by it and keys every result on it. |
| `title` | STRING | **no** | Best title the retailer has for the item (ERP or e-commerce). Resolve fallbacks in the adapter, e.g. COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(erp_title), ''), web_title). |
| `title_alt` | STRING | yes | Secondary or long title; extra context for search and for the model. |
| `brand` | STRING | yes | Brand recorded by the retailer. NULL when unknown: the agent then discovers and verifies it. |
| `supplier` | STRING | yes | Supplier or vendor of the item (a hint for the research, never evidence). |
| `department_id` | STRING | yes | Id of the top taxonomy level (department or section). |
| `department` | STRING | yes | Name of the top taxonomy level. |
| `category_id` | STRING | **no** | Id of the middle taxonomy level (category). |
| `category` | STRING | **no** | Name of the category, as reviewers know it. |
| `subcategory_id` | STRING | **no** | Id of the leaf taxonomy level; attribute applicability (v_attributes) is keyed on it. With a two-level taxonomy, repeat the category. |
| `subcategory` | STRING | **no** | Name of the subcategory. |
| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | yes | FALSE excludes the item from enrichment and from the app. NULL counts as TRUE. |
| `source_updated_at` | TIMESTAMP | yes | Last change of the item in the source (informational). |

## `v_attributes`

BrickFill canonical attributes (contract v1). One row per attribute and subcategory where it applies: the attribute matrix the enrichment fills for every product of the subcategory. Primary key (attribute_id, subcategory_id). An attribute with active rows in v_attribute_options has a controlled vocabulary.

| Column | Type | Nullable | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attribute_id` | STRING | **no** | Retailer's id of the attribute. |
| `attribute_name` | STRING | **no** | Display name of the attribute in the catalog language (shown to the model and to reviewers). |
| `attribute_description` | STRING | yes | Guidance on what the attribute means or how to fill it; sent to the model. |
| `subcategory_id` | STRING | **no** | Subcategory where the attribute applies (v_products.subcategory_id). |
| `category_id` | STRING | yes | Category of the subcategory (denormalized, for readability). |
| `subcategory` | STRING | yes | Name of the subcategory (denormalized, for readability). |
| `is_required` | BOOLEAN | yes | Whether the attribute must be filled for the subcategory. NULL falls back to the job parameter attributes_required_default. |
| `value_type` | STRING | yes | Kind of value; NULL means text. One of: `text`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`. |
| `unit` | STRING | yes | Unit of numeric values (cm, g, W, in, ...). When set, the vocabulary may hold bare numbers and the code matches 16,44 cm to 16.44. |
| `attribute_role` | STRING | yes | Semantic role used by the deterministic matching (brand aliases, taxonomy guard). NULL means other. One of: `brand`, `manufacturer`, `supplier`, `model`, `color`, `size`, `taxonomy`, `other`. |
| `allows_free_text` | BOOLEAN | yes | Only meaningful when the attribute has options: TRUE makes them suggestions instead of a closed list. NULL counts as FALSE. |
| `sort_order` | INT | yes | Display order of the attribute in the review app. |

## `v_attribute_options`

BrickFill canonical attribute options (contract v1). The allowed values (vocabulary) of each attribute; a value is published only when it matches one of them exactly or by an approved alias. Primary key (attribute_id, option_id).

| Column | Type | Nullable | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attribute_id` | STRING | **no** | Attribute the option belongs to (v_attributes.attribute_id). |
| `option_id` | STRING | **no** | Retailer's id of the option. |
| `option_value` | STRING | **no** | The value exactly as it must be published. |
| `sort_order` | INT | yes | Display order of the option. |
| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | yes | FALSE retires the option. NULL counts as TRUE. |
